title: *Pre-Sale* 3-in-1 Poncho
description:
After so many years, the 3-in-1 Poncho is back!! This piece has been around for over a decade and it was our best seller for so long. This soft bamboo/cotton blend jersey piece can be worn all year round! It's the most versatile piece you will own. Wear it as a poncho, a skirt, or a dress! You will definitely want to take this with you on your travels. Snuggle up on the plane or in the evenings as a poncho, pair with our Cupcake tank for a day on the town as a skirt, or wear it as a dress for a night out!

Fit: True to size, we recommend choosing the same size as you would in our Maxi Dress.

title: *Pre-Sale* Men's Zip Up Hoodie
description:
The men's zip hoodie has arrived! This hoodie is made from super soft bamboo fleece  that you won't want to take off! This cozy zip hoodie has a big pocket in front and features long arms and a long torso so it will work for most body types. Grab a Buttercream Men's treat today!

  • Contents: 66% Rayon from Bamboo, 28% Cotton, 6% Spandex
  • Care: Machine wash cold gentle cycle, lay flat to dry.
  • Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Crop Cuff Pants
description:
These Crop Cuff Pants will have you swooning! We love the perfect weight of these crop pants. Featuring a 3" wide elastic waistband and perfectly placed pockets, these cuff pants will make summer so comfortable. These crops pair so beautifully with our Henley Tanks and Scoop Tees, plus they look adorable with a Zip Up Hoodie to complete that sporty look while staying comfortable. Pair these with some strappy sandals or cute runners and you're ready for the day!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Cuff Pants
description:
Another fan favourite, Cuff Pants are here! We love the perfect weight of these French terry pants. Featuring a 3" wide elastic waistband and perfectly placed pockets. Cuff Pants pair beautifully with Baseball Tees, Crew Tees and Henley's, plus they look adorable with a Zip Up Hoodie to complete that sporty look while staying comfortable. Pair these with some boots or cute runners and you're ready for the day!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Long Slim Shorts
description:
Your favourite shorts are now available for pre-sale for summer! Slim Shorts have all of the right features to keep you cool and make you comfortable. These easy-to-throw-on shorts feature a soft waistband with a drawstring elastic, pockets and are made of a soft and stretchy bamboo blend French terry. 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Pleated Long Sleeve
description:
Snuggle into cooler days in this buttery-soft long sleeve! The higher neckline and cozy sleeves keep winter at bay, while the scooped hem and back pleat adds personality. Pair it with jeans for a casual look or leggings for all-day comfort - your new winter uniform awaits!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Waffle Sweatshirt
description:
Cozy up in textured comfort with this waffle sweatshirt, featuring a blend of waffle and french terry fabrics that feel as good as they look. The comfy fit pairs beautifully with our matching waffle pants for an effortlessly coordinated vibe. Your new go-to layering piece awaits!

Fit: Fits true to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Waffle Sweatpants
description:
Proudly made in Canada, these bamboo blend French Terry and waffle is a cozy dream come true! These super soft pants make the perfect pair with the Waffle Sweatshirt!

Fit: True to size. We recommend choosing the same size that you would for your Slim Pants and Cuff Pants.

title: *Pre-Sale* Scoop Tee
description:
Finally the best fitting tee out there made out of ultra soft bamboo, cotton fabric! This fit is so great for all body types. A nice loose fit on this top is flattering and so comfortable. Our tees are similar to the super popular flowy tank tops and can be worn with so many other Buttercream Clothing pieces!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* V Neck Sweater Vest
description:
Layer up in style with this effortlessly cute sweater knit vest, the perfect addition to your cozy wardrobe. Made with care and designed for versatility, this vest features a relaxed fit and a flattering V-neckline, making it ideal for layering over your favorite tops. Pair it with our brand new Turtleneck Top for the ultimate chic combo. 

Fit: fits true to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Sundae Dress
description:
The Sundae Dress is perfect for those whimsical summer days. Featuring a gathered elastic waistband and cut just above the knee, this dress is lightweight and effortless. The best part? Pockets! Need we say more?

Fit: The Sundae Dress fits small on the bust in sizes xxs - 2x; we recommend sizing up one size. 3x - 6x fits true to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Long Sleeve Biscottee
description:
This buttery-soft top does it all with cozy long sleeves and a gorgeous neckline that keeps the cold out. The raglan-style top has been a favourite for years so don't miss out on it while it is back. The Biscottee is fitted through the shoulders and sits off the body in a straight cut through the torso with a scooped bottom hem. 
 
We love pairing this top with jeans or leggings for a super easy outfit! 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Button Up Vest
description:
The Button Up Vest is our cute new take on our Button Up Cardi. Made of our soft sweater knit fabric, the buttons are adorable and are functional too! We love this one tucked in for a polished look.


Fit: True-to-size, we suggest choosing your usual Buttercream size or sizing up if you want this piece to fit looser. The fit can be compared to the Zip Up Hoodie or the Sorbet Sweater for sizing.

title: *Pre-Sale* Sleeveless Crew Split Sweater
description:
Crafted from the same soft knit as our sorbet sweater, this sleeveless crew sweater drapes in a relaxed, loose fit that feels as good as it looks. The cute split hem at the bottom adds personality to every outfit - dress it up with work pants for the office, or keep it casual with your favorite leisure wear. Versatile, comfy, and ready for anything.

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Crop Hoodie
description:
This cropped beauty features long sleeves that balance perfectly with the cropped, fitted silhouette. The tailored cuff hugs your waist just right. It's the refresh your collection has been waiting for... cozy, comfy and so cute!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* The Gathered Top
description:
Effortless style meets comfort in The Gathered Top, crafted from our soft bamboo jersey blend that feels as good as it looks. The strategic ruching below the bust creates a beautiful silhouette that works beautifully with your go-to work pants. Perfect for days when you want to look polished without trying too hard.

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Sleeveless Cowl Sweater
description:
A new cowl top with all of the best features! This top features a cowl, a cross back and loose fit over the body. Perfect for layering under your Cardi Coat or your favourite blazer. Made of our beautiful sweater knit fabric, this top has the perfect drape to it!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Pinafore Dress
description: The Pinafore Dress is back! This dress, which is made from our soft and breathable French terry fabric, hits just above the knee and features 2 patch pockets in front with a V neck. Wear it alone or over your favourite blouse and heels, or style it more casually with your favourite sneakers.

title: *Pre-Sale* Long Sleeve V Neck Tee
description:
Are you looking for a shirt that's easy to style, super-cool and totally comfortable? Look no further. Our Long Sleeve V Neck Tee is the wardrobe staple you've been searching for. This is made out of the same soft bamboo jersey blend fabric as our popular Crew Tee and fits very similarly.

Fit: Slim fit. We recommend sizing up if you want a relaxed fit.

title: *Pre-Sale* Leisure Pants
description:
Wrap yourself in comfort with these French Terry Leisure Pants, your new go-to for chilly days and relaxation mode. Designed with a loose fit and straight leg, they feature practical side seam pockets plus two back pockets. The soft elastic waistband ensures all-day comfort, whether you're sipping hot cocoa on the couch or running errands around town. Pair them with your favourite tee or hoodie for effortless style.

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Best Friend V Neck
description:
The Best Friend Tee with a "v" neck is here and ready to become your new go-to! This isn't just any tee - it's your new best friend! The length hits just right, the sleeves land perfectly, and that relaxed-but-not-sloppy fit means it works with literally everything in your closet. Whether you're dressing it up or keeping it casual, this tee adapts to your vibe. Grab your favorites now.  Just like your original Best Friend Tees, we just know you will love this 'v' neck!

Fit: True to size. Best Friend Tees are meant to have a relaxed fit so we recommend ordering your usual size in this one.

title: *Pre-Sale* Cross Back Long Sleeve
description:
This beautiful new long-sleeve top has all of the best features. The cross back feature in the back allows for coverage while still allowing for a peek-a-boo effect, depending upon how you wear it.

You have the option to tie this top in the back for an interesting look or leave it loose for a relaxed, flowy fit. We love this top over jeans or leggings.

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Work Pants
description:
We are so excited to bring you to the Work Pants in more colours! These have become a community favourite and a work staple. Work Pants are here to keep you comfortable! 
 
Made of soft, stretchy Ponte de Roma fabric, the Work Pants fit close on the hips and then taper beautifully to the ankle. This is a “cigarette” pant fit. The Work Pants are an instant classic with their straight fit and comfortable fabric that looks chic and professional for the office. Pair this with a blouse and blazer, knit sweater, or a classic tee for a polished and sophisticated look. You will not want to take these off after a day at work! 

Fit: True to size. Similar to the Slim Pants

*A note about these pants. Based on community feedback, some customers find these to fit generously. If you would like a slim fit, we recommend sizing down one size. Please reach out to us at hello@buttercreamclothing.com at any time.

title: *Pre-Sale* Tie Flowy Tank
description:
This is your favourite flowy tank, with the cutest little tie detail added at the shoulders! The little tie feature on the top of the shoulders is sewn down so no need to fuss with ties!

This tank is loose-fitting in all the right places. It's perfect for layering under other pieces or as a stand-alone piece. And it's easy to throw on - no matter how much time you have in the morning!

Fit: Fits generously. This tank fits similarly to the Flowy Tank but is looser over the body as it is intended to have a more billowy fit.

title: *Pre-Sale* Ruffle Sweatshirt
description:
Wrap yourself in cozy comfort with our adorable Ruffle Sweatshirt - the perfect blend of casual and cute. Crafted from soft French terry, this sweatshirt features a charming scoop ruffle detail on the bodice that adds a playful touch to your everyday wardrobe.  

Fit: Fitted, fits true to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Button Tunic
description:
Meet our new Button Tunic, crafted from our soft sweater knit fabric. It features a charming asymmetrical detail with functional side buttons on the left side, which makes this top breastfeeding friendly! This piece is designed for comfort, and the generous, loose fit is amazing on all body types. 

Fit: True-to-size, loose-fitting.

title: *Pre-Sale* Perfect Tee
description:
Another favourite tee for your collection, this one is just Perfect! We have been wanting to launch a basic fitting - relaxed tee and this one fits the bill!
The longer fit pairs great with Lolli Leggings, and you can pretty much wear it with any of your favourite bottoms, depending on your mood! Enjoy! Made from our soft jersey bamboo blend!

Fit: True to size. Relaxed fit.

title: *Pre-sale* Tank Romper
description:
Meet your new go-to romper! Crafted from soft, breathable jersey fabric, this Tank Romper is designed for all-day comfort. The tapered legs finish with a cute cuff at the ankle, while hidden pockets keep your essentials close. Layer it with a crop jacket or Cozy Up Cardi Coat, and pair it with flats and sneakers for a laid-back vibe. Versatile, comfy, and oh-so-wearable.

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Ruched Waist Straight Leg Pants
description:
These are THE pants! We just know that you will love the new Ruched Waist Straight Leg Pants! Comfort meets everyday style with these pull-on pants featuring a soft, ruched elastic waistband, pockets and a relaxed fit. Throw them on with your favourite hoodie for a laid-back look, or dress them up with a tank and blazer for casual office days. Made from our French Terry fabric, these pants feel as good as they look.

Contact us at hello@buttercreamclothing.com for more colour options!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Yoga Pant
description:
You asked, we listened - we think these yoga pants will be here to stay! Move through your day with ease in these stay-put yoga pants that transition seamlessly from studio sessions to casual outings. The wide fitted waistband keeps everything secure without rolling, while the straight-leg silhouette offers a comfortable, loose fit. Premium legging fabric provides the comfort and support you need, whether you're flowing through poses or running errands. And yes, functional pockets are included, because who doesn't love a place to stash their essentials?

Fit: True to size. We recommend choosing the same size that you would for your Lolli Leggings.

title: *Pre-Sale* Sorbet Sweater
description:
The Sorbet Sweater was designed for comfort! We created a lightweight sweater knit top that we know you will love! This all-season sweater is made of a modal blend fabric that is stretchy and so soft. The crew neck is so perfect for more coverage. Whether you are lounging around the house or wanting some comfort at work, this is the perfect top.

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Pavlova Palazzo Pants
description:
Palazzo Pants are going to be our new favourite Buttercream classic! Palazzo Pants are made out of our popular Work Pants fabric and we know that they will become another wardrobe staple.

Palazzo Pants feature two pleats in the front and darts in the back to create a perfectly-fitting waist. The waistband features a comfortable 1/2" elastic sewn into the top of the band to prevent twisting of the waistband and to keep your pants in the perfect spot. The legs are loose-fitting for a modern silhouette.

Fit: True to size. Similar to the Work Pants.

title: *Pre-Sale* Zip Up Hoodie
description:
If you’re looking for a layer that will keep you comfortable and warm but also a little sporty; something that is perfect for wearing around the house, but also great for running errands or going out with your kids, look no further! 

Our Zip Up Hoodie is just what you've been looking for. This soft bamboo blend fleece hoodie has an adorable hood lining feature, so you can stay warm while still looking cute! It's perfect for layering over your favourite tank top or tee. The zipper makes it easy to throw on over anything else in your closet—it pairs well with leggings and jeans alike!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Half-Sleeve Bodysuit - V Neck
description:
By popular demand, we are introducing the new half sleeve bodysuit! This lovely sleeve is nice and long for a pretty silhouette. The perfect base layer for any outfit, the Half-Sleeve Bodysuit has a v-neck with an ultra-comfortable fit. This bodysuit is perfect to layer with any of your Buttercream pieces!

Fit: Fits close to the body, we recommend sizing up if you would prefer a loose fit. 

*Due to the nature of this garment, this is a final sale item and is not eligible for exchanges or returns.

title: *Pre-Sale* 3/4 Sleeve Heart Cut-Out Circle Dress
description:
A sweet little heart cut-out in the back of this dress adds the cutest detail!! The Circle Skirt has been altered to create the Circle Dress and this time it features a 3/4 sleeve just in time for winter! This sweet little one-piece features an elegant neckline, a sewn-in waistband, a billowing skirt, a heart cut out in the back panel, and, of course, pockets. The Circle Dress hits just below the knee for most and is such a darling addition to your Buttercream wardrobe!
 








Fit: true-to-size

title: *Pre-Sale* Cowl Top
description:
A delightful Cowl Top is here for you! This beautiful top is exactly what this season calls for. You can certainly dress this top up with Work Pants or a Pencil Skirt or dress it down with jeans or Cuff Pants.

This top is made of the same fabric as the Sorbet Sweater (a soft knit) and fits very similarly to the Sorbet.

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Dulce Sweater
description: Snuggle into sweetness with this charming sweater knit top, made ethically in Canada with love and care. Featuring a relaxed fit and an adorable button detail at the neckline, this top is the perfect balance of comfort and style. Whether you’re sipping on hot cocoa, strolling through a winter market, or just cozying up at home, this piece will keep you looking and feeling delightful all day long!

title: *Pre-Sale* Half-Sleeve Bodysuit - Scoop Neck
description:
By popular demand, we are introducing the new half sleeve bodysuit! This lovely sleeve is nice and long for a pretty silhouette. The perfect base layer for any outfit, the Half-Sleeve Bodysuit has a scoop neck with an ultra-comfortable fit. This bodysuit is perfect to layer with any of your Buttercream pieces!

Fit: Fits close to the body, we recommend sizing up if you would prefer a loose fit. 

*Due to the nature of this garment, this is a final sale item and is not eligible for exchanges or returns.

title: *Pre-Sale* Tank Heart Cut-Out Circle Dress
description:
A sweet little heart cut-out in the back of this dress adds the cutest detail!! The Circle Skirt has been altered to create the Circle Dress! This sweet little one-piece features an elegant neckline, a sewn-in waistband, a billowing skirt, a heart cut out in the back panel, and, of course, pockets. The Circle Dress hits just below the knee for most and is such a darling addition to your Buttercream wardrobe!
 








Fit: true-to-size

title: *Pre-Sale* Short Sleeve Henley
description:
The Short Sleeve Henley has become a Buttercream favourite over the years! This perfect tee has beautiful features like functioning snaps (which makes this top breastfeeding friendly), a cuff at the bicep, a scooped bottom hem and a decorative seam up the back. 
 
The Short Sleeve Henley fits true-to-size (exactly like the long sleeve version) and pairs perfectly with Lolli Leggings.

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Crew Tee
description:
The quintessential classic Crew Tee - is there anything more versatile in our wardrobes? It’s easy to see why this fan-favourite deserves to be a closet staple. You are the artist and, when it comes to styling this top, you just can’t go wrong. Wear this top underneath a jumper or cardigan or pair it with some leggings and an infinity scarf for some instant chic. Featuring the same high-quality bamboo blend jersey fabric that you’ve come to know and love in Buttercream products; we know you’re going to love the way this top makes you feel! 

Fit: true to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Maxi Dress
description:
Looking fantastic has never been so effortless. Throw it on while your shoulders soak up the sun or add a cardi to amp this dress up to another level. The beauty of this garment is that it can seamlessly transition from that morning stroll along the beach into that perfect evening dinner or even to a summer wedding. The best part? You can hide those sunglasses in your pocket while sampling hors d'oeuvres. The fitted bust and loose skirt hang comfortably around your body.


Fit: These dresses have a generous fit, we recommend sizing down one size in sizes 1x-6x as the bust fits generously in those sizes (unless you have a larger bust measurement).

title: *Pre-Sale* Crew Neck Puff Sleeve Top
description:
A classic fit with the most darling details! The Crew Neck Puff Sleeve Top is the perfect addition to any collection. Made of our oh-so-soft sweater knit fabric, the Crew Neck Puff Sleeve will keep you cozy all day long. Jeans, leggings, or a simple skirt all pair perfectly with this top! 

Fit: True to size. Choose the same size you would for the Crew Tee or Sorbet Sweater.

title: *Pre-Sale* Flowy Crop Pants
description:
Your favourite pants are back!! We've got you covered! The Flowy Crop Pants are the perfect blend of comfort and polish. These are a new take on a garment from the Buttercream Vault - back for a limited time.
 
The Flowy Crop Pants are made out of our soft bamboo blend jersey with a flat waistband. Pair these beautiful pants with a bodysuit, heels and a cute bag for a dressy look or pop on sandals and a comfy tee for a casual look. You're going to love these versatile, classic Flowy Crop Pants. 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Sweatshirt Dress
description:
Our beloved Sweatshirt Dress is back to keep you cozy at the office or to cuddle up in at home! 
 
Nothing is better than a versatile piece for these cooler months - look no further! The Sweatshirt Dress is the perfect garment to layer with leggings or tights, a statement necklace and boots for a night out, or cozied up with a hot chocolate, fire-side. Wrap yourself up in the softest French terry fabric.
 

Fit: True to size

title: *Pre-Sale* Long Sleeve Henley
description:
This much-loved Henley top is back in beautiful colours! Over the years, this has become of our most popular styles and we are thrilled to bring it back! The Long Sleeve Henley features a beautiful scooped neck, functional snaps, cuffs at the wrist, a decorative stitch up the back and a scooped bottom hem. 

Long Sleeve Henley snaps make this top perfect for breastfeeding! 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Heart Button Up Cardi
description:
Welcome the Heart Button Up Cardi to the Buttercream Family!
 
The Heart Button Up Cardi is made of our medium-weight French Terry fabric. It has the sweetest (functional) heart-shaped buttons, a drop shoulder and cuffs at the wrist. 

We just love this layer for a cozy and stylish accent to your favourite basics. 


Fit: true-to-size, we suggest choosing your usual Buttercream size or sizing up if you want this piece to fit looser. The fit can be compared to the Zip Up Hoodie or the Sorbet Sweater for sizing.

title: *Pre-Sale* Half-Zip
description:
Half the zip but ALL the style and comfort! We are so excited to introduce the Half-Zip - a piece we have been working on for some time now. This gorgeous top features a partial zip and a classic collar with fun colour-blocking - all in the softest French Terry. Channel your inner skier, hike the gorgeous Rockies or cozy up with the timeless, yet retro vibes of this adorable Half-Zip. Choose from bright and complimentary colour blocks or neutrals, all in a classic fit. 

Fit: These fit small so we recommend to size up one size

title: *Pre-Sale* Cupcake Tank
description:
Whether you dress it up or dress it down, wear it alone or wear it layered, a simple tank top holds copious amounts of fashion power. Tuck it into a pair of sweats one day and wear it under a blazer the next; this is one item you can't go without. This tank is the form-fitted version of our Flowy Tank. It layers extremely well and looks adorable with a jean jacket or paired with our Maxi Skirt.

Fit: Slim fit.

title: *Pre-Sale* Half Sleeve Tie Romper
description:
The new Half Sleeve Tie Romper is a welcome addition to our collection as we know how much you loved the original Tie Romper with the tank top sleeve! We just had to bring this one to the site with a half sleeve for the cooler months and for layering with all of your favourite Buttercream outerwear (including the new Layer Cardi). 

The Tie Romper features a tie at the waist, sleeves to the elbow and a wide leg. This comfortable romper is so great paired with a Layer Cardi. Dress this darling romper up or down! We know you are going to just love how comfortable it is! 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Cozy Up Cardi
description:
The Cozy Up Cardi is here! This delightful duster-length cardi will see you through all seasons. We are so in love with this design and we know you will be too! This elevated cardigan features a flat lapel that creates such a nice drape, patch pockets, a cuff at the wrist and a duster length. Pair the Cozy Up Cardi with your new Mock Neck Tie Dress for a beautiful silhouette. The Cozy Up Cardi is made of our beautiful bamboo blend jersey. 

Fit: True to size. Fits the same as your Sugar Dusters.

title: *Pre-Sale* Crop Pocket Lolli Legging
description:
Another great addition to your Lolli Legging collection! The crop version sits at about mid-calf length. They have 2 large pockets on the side seams so you can store your phone, keys and wallet. Wear them for yoga, at home or out on the weekends!

These leggings were made using our incredibly soft athletic fabric with great compression!

Fit: True to size. We recommend ordering the same size as our classic Lolli Leggings.

*A note about our black Lolli legging fabric: this fabric is slightly less buttery soft and less stretchy than our colour fabrics for Lolli leggings. The black Lolli leggings provide a bit more of a dressy look and are a great staple piece in your wardrobe.

title: *Pre-Sale* Cowl Sweatshirt (FLEECE)
description:
Whether you're camping or heading to the hockey game, this cowl sweatshirt will keep you warm and cozy. The kangaroo pocket and cuffs at the wrist and waistband allow for easy movement, and the faux leather label by @brickbubble adds a beautiful design detail. The bamboo blend fleece feels like a marshmallow hug every time you put it on and you will not want to take this one off!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Cardi Coat
description:
Not only does the Cardi Coat look amazing, it is functional with two big pockets for all of your necessities. Wear it to the office with dress pants and a silk blouse, or pair it with a casual tee, leggings and your favourite boots to carry you through the weekend.

Made from our bamboo blend French Terry and featuring a lapel collar, this cardi will be your go-to piece for easy dressing and you'll never want to take it off!

Fit: Generous fit.

title: *Pre-Sale* Boatneck Top
description:
The Perfect Top does exist! Say hello to the Boatneck Top! 

This dreamy top checks all the boxes! We have had so many requests for a 3/4-sleeve boatneck top that we just had to make the perfect one. The Boatneck Top features an elegant neckline with an open neck that still covers your bra straps and sits at just the right spot for comfort. The stitching around the neck is so exquisite and the sleeve length and fit on the body make this top such a classic to throw on. This top can be dressed up or down and will carry you through many occasions and seasons.

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Caramel Cardi
description:
The Caramel Cardi is the perfect blend of cozy and comfortable. It's made from a bamboo blend French terry. The cross-over lapel makes it easy to wear, whether you're looking for something that can be worn as an outer layer or just as a cozy layer under your favorite coat. It features 2 snaps and pockets!

Fit: Fits true-to-size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Sugar Duster
description:
Add an instant polished look to your attire. We've designed this duster to look good from every angle, compliment every outfit and work overtime in every season. The lightweight bamboo jersey (the same material as our popular layer cardi) allows for sophisticated layering at the office or functional layering while lounging, all without sacrificing comfort or style. The duster is elevated with much-loved side seam pockets and falls approximately at knee length. This is a staple that will be worn on repeat!

Fit: True to size. Fits the same as your Layer Cardigans.

title: *Pre-Sale* Best Friend Tee
description:
The Best Friend Tee is back and ready to become your new go-to. This isn't just any tee - it's your new best friend! The length hits just right, the sleeves land perfectly, and that relaxed-but-not-sloppy fit means it works with literally everything in your closet. Whether you're dressing it up or keeping it casual, this tee adapts to your vibe. Grab your favorites now.

Fit: True to size. Best Friend Tees are meant to have a relaxed fit so we recommend ordering your usual size in this one.

title: *Pre-Sale* Hooded Coat
description:
You never know where your day may take you, so be prepared with this layering essential to ensure you always stay warm and cozy. This open-front style features pockets and a roomy hood. We love how it transitions perfectly from those lazy-day movies on the couch to when you need to race out the door and have it all together in public.

Fit: Generous fit.

title: *Pre-Sale* Baseball Tee
description:
Always a classic, this cute baseball tee is so sporty and sweet at the same time. We love the rounded hem which means the sides will be slightly shorter than the front and back. This top is lightweight and cool. We love this top with leggings and sneakers, but it's also great with a pair of shorts or your favourite denim! Hit it out of the park with this beautiful top!

Fit: Relaxed fit.

title: *Pre-Sale* Ballet Top
description:
The beautiful Ballet Top is finally back! This darling top can be worn with so many different outfits and will become a fast favourite. The Ballet Top features a half-sleeve, a fitted body and snaps at the shoulder to secure bra straps in place.   
Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Layer Cardi
description:
The Layer Cardi is back! This open-style cardigan is made of a deliciously soft jersey fabric and makes for the perfect lightweight layer over any outfit. We are featuring a beautiful ribbing jersey this time in lots of gorgeous colours! Pairs perfectly with the new Half Sleeve Tie Romper. 

Fit: True to size. Fits the same as your Pumpkin Spice Cardigans

title: *Pre-Sale* Flowy Pants (full length)
description:
The Flowy Pants are here in new colours in our jersey blend again! Once you slip these pants on, they will be the only things you’ll want to wear.  They have all the comfort of sweatpants with all the style of a dressy pants. They have a lovely high waist which drapes beautifully and floats away from the body. They have a generous cut to give you maximum comfort. The little gathering detail under the waistband is so pretty and allows you to take them to the office, out for dinner, and beyond. 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Cuff Tee
description:
The Cuff Tee is the perfect way to keep your wardrobe looking fresh. The Cuff Tee features a straight fit over the body and a high scooped neckline. It is roomy enough to be comfortable, but still tailored enough to give you a polished look. The “x” stitch detail on the cuff at the sleeve adds the sweetest detail, while the fit keeps things simple and clean.

Fit: Generously, we recommend staying with your regular size for a relaxed fit, sizing down for a slim fit.

title: *Pre-Sale* Dulce Dress
description:
The Dulce Dress returns. This adorable dress features a half sleeve, a cowl neck with button details and pockets! Perfect for the office or dinner out, the Dulce Dress will take you places!


Fit: Fits small in the bust - many choose to size up one size. Made of French terry.

title: *Pre-Sale* Ruched Tie Long Sleeve
description:
Cozy meets cute with this long sleeve sweater knit top! Featuring a functional ruched tie detail at the hem - you'll want to live in this one! Style it with jeans, sweats, leggings or office pants... this one is versatile! Wear this one long or tied up for a sweet ruched look!

Fit: True to size. Fit is similar to the Sorbet Sweater.

title: *Pre-Sale* Long Sleeve Frill Top
description:
Just like the Frill Tank, but with Long Sleeves to get you through the cooler months wit ha little extra charm! This top features a scoop neck, a ruffle at the bottom and a sweet seam in the front of the bodice. 

The Frill Top is perfect paired with your favorite denim, and is a sweet way to dress up your Lolli Leggings!

Fit: True-to-size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Sleeveless Hoodie
description:
Meet your new layering obsession! This sleeveless hoodie in soft French terry is the perfect lightweight essential for any season. The oversized kangaroo pocket is ideal for keeping your hands warm or stashing your essentials. Throw it over a tee, pair it with a long sleeve, or wear it solo - this cozy piece is endlessly versatile and ready for whatever adventure comes next.

Fit: True to size

title: *Pre-Sale* Bodysuit
description:
The perfect base layer for any outfit. A nice scoop neck tank top and a medium cut on the bottom. This piece is perfect to layer with any of your Buttercream pieces!

Fit: True to size. 

*Due to the nature of this garment, this is a final sale item and is not eligible for exchanges or returns.

title: *Pre-Sale* Split Tee
description:
The split tee is such a fun tee to style and layer! This gorgeous tee has long slits up the side making it perfect for wearing over a tank top and leggings for a peek-a-boo look! 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-sale* Cuff Dress
description:
The Cuff Dress is here for you!

Think Cuff Tee turned into a dress with stunning details!

The Cuff Dress has the exact same fit as the Cuff Tee on the top half and then a beautiful loose-fitting bottom half. This dress really does it all! Dress it up with heels and a blazer for work or dress it down with sneakers and a jacket for a casual day out.

Cuff Dresses feature a beautiful neckline, cuffed sleeves with a darling "x" stitching detail on the sleeve, a loose fit over the body, and, of course, pockets!!

Fit: generous; we recommend ordering the same size as your Cuff Tee.

title: *Pre-Sale* Lolli Crop
description:
Lolli Leggings are a fan favourite around here. With the perfect amount of stretch and the most buttery of fabrics, we just can't get enough of these! These crops sit at about mid-calf length and are perfect for summer.

Fit: True to size

*A note about our black Lolli legging fabric: this fabric is slightly less buttery soft and less stretchy than our colour fabrics for Lolli leggings. The black Lolli leggings provide a bit more of a dressy look and are a great staple piece in your wardrobe.

title: *Pre-Sale* Comfy Cozy Sweatshirt
description:
Get ready to get comfy with the Comfy Cozy Sweatshirt!! This is one that you will never want to take off. Made with soft French terry, this sweet sweatshirt is designed with a relaxed oversized fit, drop shoulder, and convenient side slits. The classic crew neck completes this versatile piece, perfect for layering or wearing on its own. Pair with your favourite Lolli Leggings or denim! 

Fabric: French terry 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Wrap Dress
description:
The Wrap Dress is back and we are so happy to share it with you! This dress is a faux wrap, it is sewn together where the bodice and the skirt cross over so you can just pull this one on without having to fuss. The removable belt is so versatile (with no belt loops on the dress) so you can choose to wear it with or without the belt. The neckline of this beautiful dress is so comfortable, with fabric binding sewn at the neck to keep everything in place. It has a gorgeous flutter sleeve that hits mid-arm. 

This dress is so perfect for breastfeeding, a wedding, or just every day! It is made of our beautiful bamboo jersey blend and of course, we just had to add pockets!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Lace Sweatshirt
description:
The Lace Sweatshirt is all about comfort while looking polished! This adorable piece features a lace panel for an extra level of style. 

Fit: Generously, some people like to size down in this one. Stay with your regular size for a relaxed fit.

title: *Pre-Sale* Frill Tank
description:
We love a sweet frill to add some detail to a comfortable top! The Frill Tank is here and it is adorable! This top features a scoop neck, a ruffle at the bottom and a sweet seam in the front of the bodice. 

The Frill Tank is perfect paired with your favorite denim and will be such a lovely layer this summer!

Fit: True-to-size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Flutter Sleeve Top
description:
The Flutter Sleeve Top is a delightful addition to your Buttercream Clothing wardrobe. This top features a gorgeous sleeve with lots of movement and good coverage. The Flutter Sleeve Top has a scoop neckline with a subtle v-neck feature and a fitted band at the hips, which creates a beautiful drape.

Wear this top to work, under a blazer or cardigan, or out on the town with friends. 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Sprinkle Cake Tank
description:
The Sprinkle Cake Tank is here and it is so chic and adorable!! Our amazing seamstress, Cristina, designed this tank with so much love and pride. 

Pair this tank with work pants and a blazer for a business-casual look or with jean shorts or leggings for a comfortable and easy outfit.
 
We are all so in love with how the Sprinkle Cake Tanks turned out! 

Fit: True-to-size. Fits like the Cupcake Tank.

title: *Pre-Sale* Long Sleeve Turtleneck
description:
Elevate your everyday style with this sleek and versatile bamboo blend jersey turtleneck.  Perfect for layering or wearing on its own, this turtleneck adds a touch of timeless sophistication to any outfit. This turtleneck pairs perfectly with our new V Neck Sweater Vest.

Fit: fits small like our bodysuits. Please size up by one size if you would like a more relaxed fit.

title: *Pre-Sale* Shortbread Cowl Top
description: Wrap yourself in cozy sweetness with this adorable French terry cowl top, made ethically in Canada with love and care as always. This relaxed fit and playful side slits add a touch of detail. Whether you’re strolling to your favorite bakery, sipping on a latte, or simply enjoying a cozy day at home, this top is your go-to for effortless style and comfort. It’s the perfect mix of sugar, spice, and everything nice for your wardrobe!

title: *Pre-Sale* Tie Dress
description:
We have just brought back the beautiful Tie Dress and we are just so excited to share it with you!
 
The Tie Dress is the perfect dress for so many events: work, baby showers, weddings, dates, brunch, errands, or church! This dress fits loosely over the body with a gorgeous tie at the waist that can be tied at the front or back - so great for two different looks!

Fit: These dresses fit true to size; we recommend choosing your usual Buttercream size. The fit can be compared to the Truffle Dress or Twist Dress. Made of our gorgeous bamboo blend jersey, it is the perfect weight for spring and summer.

title: *Pre-Sale* Flowy Pocket Tank
description:
The Flowy Pocket Tank is back! This adorable tank top features an A-line cut, a pocket at the bust and a scooped hem. Wear this tank loose for a relaxed fit or tie it with a knot to create a more fitted silhouette. 

Fit: True to size. Fits the same as the Flowy Tank.

title: *Pre-sale* Short Sleeve Biscottee
description:
This buttery-soft top does it all with these generous short sleeves and a gorgeous neckline. The raglan-style top has been a favourite for years, so don't miss out on it while it is back. The Short Sleeve Biscottee is fitted through the shoulders and sits off the body in a straight cut through the torso with a scooped bottom hem. 
 
We love pairing this top with jeans or leggings for a super easy outfit! 


Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Tiramisu Tunic
description:
Made with deliciously soft bamboo/cotton jersey, this scoop-neck top was designed to cover bra straps and has 3/4-length sleeves that can be worn long or pushed up to the elbow. The scalloped hem scoops long in the front and even longer in the back. This pairs perfectly with our Lolli Leggings.

Fit: true to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Henley Tank
description:
The classic Henley Tank is ready to take on those warm weather temps and give you effortless comfort. Try this top with some denim cutoffs or a Circle Skirt and layer it under a cardi with leggings when the nights cool down. This tank is sure to become one of your new summer favourites.

Henley Tanks feature functional snaps which makes this top perfect for breastfeeding! 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* 7/8 Pocket Lolli Legging
description:
Pocket Lolli Leggings are perfect for so many activities! They have 2 large pockets on the side seams so you can store your phone, keys and wallet. The high-waisted fit is about an inch higher than our regular Lolli Leggings, so they sit comfortably above the belly button without being too tight. Wear them for yoga, at home or out on the weekends!

These leggings were made using our incredibly soft athletic fabric with great compression!

Fit: True to size. We recommend ordering the same size as our classic Lolli Leggings.

*A note about our black Lolli legging fabric: this fabric is slightly less buttery soft and less stretchy than our colour fabrics for Lolli leggings. The black Lolli leggings provide a bit more of a dressy look and are a great staple piece in your wardrobe.

title: *Pre-Sale* Summer Swing Dress
description:
The perfect dress to take you from day to night, this summer swing dress is a must-have for your closet. The A-line silhouette and easy fit make it a great option for everyday wear. This dress looks great on everyone! Pair the Summer Swing Dress with your Lolli Shorties for an outfit that will surely be on repeat!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Tall Pavlova Palazzo Pants
description:
Palazzo Pants are going to be our new favourite Buttercream classic! Palazzo Pants are made out of our popular Work Pants fabric and we know that they will become another wardrobe staple.

Palazzo Pants feature two pleats in the front and darts in the back to create a perfectly-fitting waist. The waistband features a comfortable 1/2" elastic sewn into the top of the band to prevent twisting of the waistband and to keep your pants in the perfect spot. The legs are loose-fitting for a modern silhouette.

Fit: True to size. Similar to the Work Pants.

title: *Pre-Sale* Tall Lolli Legging (High-Waisted)
description:
You've never felt leggings like these.

Our buttery-soft, compressive leggings are made for you to feel good and look good. Whether you're hitting the gym or relaxing with your feet up, we've got you covered. We want you to feel our leggings - literally!

With the perfect amount of stretch and the most buttery of fabrics, we just can't get enough of these! We recommend regular-length leggings for those that are 5’ - 5’10”. The tall length version is great for those that are 5'11” - 6’4” tall.

Fit: True to size.

*A note about our black Lolli legging fabric: this fabric is slightly less buttery soft and less stretchy than our colour fabrics for Lolli leggings. The black Lolli leggings provide a bit more of a dressy look and are a great staple piece in your wardrobe.

description:

The Tall Flowy Pants are made out of our soft bamboo blend jersey with a flat waistband. Pair these beautiful pants with a bodysuit, heels and a cute bag for a dressy look or pop on sandals and a comfy tee for a casual look. You're going to love these versatile, classic Flowy Pants. 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Cross Back Short Sleeve
description:
This beautiful new short-sleeve top has all of the best features. The cross back feature in the back allows for coverage while still allowing for a peek-a-boo effect, depending upon how you wear it.

You have the option to tie this top in the back for an interesting look or leave it loose for a relaxed, flowy fit. We love this top over jeans or leggings.

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* 3/4 Sleeve Circle Dress
description:
A perfect twist on a favourite! The Circle Skirt has been altered to create the Circle Dress and this time it features a 3/4 sleeve just in time for winter! This sweet little one-piece features an elegant neckline, a sewn-in waistband, a billowing skirt and, of course, pockets. The Circle Dress hits just below the knee for most and is such a darling addition to your Buttercream wardrobe.

Fit: True-to-size

title: *Pre-Sale* Lounge Pants
description:
Proudly made in Canada, these bamboo blend French Terry lounge pants are so buttery soft you won’t want to take them off… ever! With a super-soft ribbed elastic waist, a drawstring on the inside of the waistband and cute patch pockets, these will become your go-to lounge pants.

Fit: True to size. We recommend choosing the same size that you would for your Slim Pants and Cuff Pants.

title: *Pre-Sale* Men's Crew Tee
description:
We are so excited to bring back our men's tees! The classic cut of the long and short tees, make for an incredibly flattering fit. Whether you are shopping for yourself or for your special someone, you can't go wrong with the men's tee.

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Men's Baseball Tee
description:
We are so excited to bring back our men's Baseball Tee! This raglan-style top is so comfortable and we know you or your partner will just love it! 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* V Neck Tee
description:
Are you looking for a shirt that's easy to style, super-cool and totally comfortable? Look no further. Our V Neck Tee is the wardrobe staple you've been searching for. This is made out of the same soft bamboo jersey blend fabric as our popular Crew Tee and fits very similarly.

Fit: Slim fit. We recommend sizing up if you want a relaxed fit.

title: *Pre-Sale* Truffle Scoop Dress
description:
Isn’t this dress the sweetest? This is the scoop neck Truffle Dress with an adorable half sleeve. The skirt falls at a midi length for you taller gals while it will fall at more of a maxi length for you shorter gals. We just love the ruffle hem line and of course all dresses must have pockets!

Fit: These dresses fit true to size - we recommend choosing the same size as you would in our Circle Dress.

title: *Pre-Sale* Long Sleeve Crew Tee
description:
The quintessential classic Long Sleeve Crew Tee - is there anything more versatile in our wardrobes? It’s easy to see why this fan-favourite deserves to be a closet staple. You are the artist and, when it comes to styling this top, you just can’t go wrong. Wear this top underneath a jumper or cardigan or pair it with some leggings and an infinity scarf for some instant chic. Featuring the same high-quality bamboo blend jersey fabric that you’ve come to know and love in Buttercream products; we know you’re going to love the way this top makes you feel! 

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Half Sleeve Cardi
description:
The Half Sleeve Cardi has arrived! This open-style cardigan is made of a deliciously soft jersey fabric and makes for the perfect layer over any outfit. 

Fit: True to size. Fits the same as your Layer Cardigans.

*Please note, the lapel has a raw edge as a design detail, this fabric folds back on itself to create a beautiful drape.

title: *Pre-Sale* Flowy Tank
description:
You know those days when you just want to throw on something comfortable, but still feel cute and put together? That's what the Flowy Tank was designed for!

This tank is loose-fitting in all the right places. It's perfect for layering under other pieces or as a stand-alone piece. And it's easy to throw on - no matter how much time you have in the morning!

How will you style your Flowy Tank?

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Tall Slim Pants
description:
Tall Slim Pants are here in the softest, bamboo blend fleece. These pants have been a community favourite since their inception and once you have yours, you'll understand why! These slim-fitting pant can be dressed up for business casual commitments and they pair well with slippers, top knots, and hot cocoa as well! Enjoy the newly updated waistband and cuffs at the ankle that are made of the same fleece fabric as the leg of these pants. We have also reinforced the stitching on the elastic waistband to ensure no flipping elastics occur by tacking down the elastic in 4 places.
 

Fit: True to size. Tall Slim Pants are best for those that are taller than 5'9.

description:

title: *Pre-Sale* Button Up Cardi
description:
Welcome the Button Up Cardi to the Buttercream Family!
 
The Button Up Cardi is made of our soft sweater knit fabric. It has functional buttons, a drop shoulder and cuffs at the wrist. 


Fit: true-to-size, we suggest choosing your usual Buttercream size or sizing up if you want this piece to fit looser. The fit can be compared to the Zip Up Hoodie or the Sorbet Sweater for sizing.

title: *Pre-Sale* Pocket Lolli Shorties
description:
We love Lolli Shorties!

The athletic cut gives you the perfect fit in all the right places. They're made of a buttery-soft fabric that keeps you cool when it's hot out - the ultimate in comfort in every way! 

What we love most about these shorts is how versatile they are. They look great with an oversized sweatshirt and sneakers for a casual look, or under a dress to prevent chafing. We reach for them often because they're just so easy to wear.

Fit: True to size.

 *A note about our black Lolli legging fabric: this fabric is slightly less buttery soft and less stretchy than our colour fabrics for Lolli leggings. The black Lolli leggings provide a bit more of a dressy look and are a great staple piece in your wardrobe.

title: *Pre-Sale* Pumpkin Spice Cardi
description:
The sweet Pumpkin Spice Cardi is back! This open-style cardigan is made of a deliciously soft sweater knit fabric and makes for the perfect medium-weight layer over any outfit. 

Fit: True to size. Fits the same as your Layer Cardigans.

title: *Pre-Sale* Sugar Short Sleeve
description:
This classic from the beginnings of Buttercream Clothing is back! We are so excited to share the updated version of the Sugar Short Sleeve with you! Toss this on with Lollis and a tank for everyday wear or dress it up with a knot and some jeans or work pants for a night out or the office. This top truly takes you wherever life leads. This top fits generously through the bust and lays softly on the body through the hips. The Sugar Short Sleeve will soon become your go-to top - don't say we didn't warn you!

Fit: True to size.

title: *Pre-Sale* Tall Work Pants
description:
We are so excited to bring you to the Tall Work Pants! These have become a community favourite and a work staple. Tall Work Pants are here to keep you comfortable! 
 
Made of soft, stretchy Ponte de Roma fabric, the Tall Work Pants fit close on the hips and then taper beautifully to the ankle. This is a “cigarette” pant fit. The Tall Work Pants are an instant classic with their straight fit and comfortable fabric that looks chic and professional for the office. Pair this with a blouse and blazer, knit sweater, or a classic tee for a polished and sophisticated look. You will not want to take these off after a day at work! 

Fit: True to size. Similar to the Slim Pants

*A note about these pants. Based on community feedback, some customers find these to fit generously. If you would like a slim fit, we recommend sizing down one size. Please reach out to us at hello@buttercreamclothing.com at any time.

title: Package Protection
description:
Add more peace of mind to your Buttercream pieces! Our team works closely with Canada Post (and others internationally) to ensure your packages arrive perfectly to you. Buttercream Package Protection ensures that if your package is lost in the mail or damaged that it will be replaced at no charge to you - a comforting ingredient to the perfect Buttercream Clothing order.

Here is how it works if you have not received your package, but it is marked as "delivered" or "lost":

With Package Protection:
Please wait three days (there is oftentimes a delay) and then contact us with your order number and the details of your package status. Your Buttercream pieces will be replaced at no cost to you.

Without Package Protection:
Please wait three days (there is oftentimes a delay) and then please contact the carrier directly. Your Buttercream pieces are able to be replaced at a cost to you.

If you have any questions at all about how this option works, please reach out to us.

title: Gift Card
description:
Shopping for someone else but not sure what to give them? Give them the gift of choice with a Buttercream Clothing gift card.

Gift cards are delivered by email and contain instructions to redeem them at checkout. Our gift cards have no additional processing fees.
